race.comment: BEL MEZYAAN (8) resumes. He was racing very well last time in with some close up efforts in good races including a narrow second to Gold Coast Belle in the Bendigo Guineas. He's trialled nicely and expecting the camp to have him pretty wound up. HEDJET (16) is the huge danger. He bounced out of the local debut to bolt in at Geelong as favourite. Did have favours there but rolls forward again and will take catching again. WETUMPKA (12) has come back very well. Dominant fresh then very good again at this trip at Seymour. Has to be a big chance again. DIAMOND EYE (15) is flying. This is tougher but have to respect. NEARING LIBERTY (9) resumes and can run well fresh.
